description:
Cause a noncreature artifact to enter the battlefield under your control, which will be an Equipment due to Bludgeon Brawl if it isn't an Equipment already, causing the living weapon ability granted by Ekthi to trigger.
Resolve the living weapon trigger granted by Ekthi, creating (and attaching the Equipment that entered to) a 0/0 black Phyrexian Germ token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature, creating a Blood token which will be an Equipment due to Bludgeon Brawl, and causing the living weapon ability granted by Ekthi to trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
